question: Where can I find a gallery within 20 kilometers, oriented toward the west of Akron Children's Hospital NICU at Summa, Akron, OH?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, wikidata, wikipedia, addr_state, addr_city, amenity, leisure, tourism, cuisine, museum, healthcare, takeaway, drive_through, outdoor_seating, emergency, restaurant FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Akron Children''s Hospital NICU at Summa%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 20000 -- 20 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Akron Children''s Hospital NICU at Summa%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 -- West direction (247.5 to 292.5 degrees) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Akron Children''s Hospital NICU at Summa%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC;
